rows.question: Find the shot of rocket engines firing, seen close.
rows.why: Close view of rocket engine firing on a test stand: the plume ignites at about 28.8 s (frame 9 at 0:28.900 shows the first orange flame, then the blue-white plume by 29.5 s) and stays on the nozzle through 0:30.166 and 0:32.566. The shot ends with a cut at 35.0 to the wide view of the V20 vacuum chamber. Based on the shot-25.3-35.0 look and the 26.5-31.0 motion sheet; I didn't view 31-35 closely beyond the two firing frames.

rows.question: Find the shot of rocket engines firing, seen close.
rows.why: The verified shot shows a close rocket-engine test with a bright firing plume, especially from about 28.5 seconds until the cut at 35.0 seconds.

rows.question: Find the shot of two people with a telescope in silhouette at dusk.
rows.why: The sheet of shot midpoints showed the two-person telescope silhouette at dusk at 1:36.966 (shot 95.0-99.0). A 1:34.5-1:39.5 look confirmed it: frames 9-14 (1:37.2-1:38.8) show a child and a man silhouetted at a telescope against a blue-to-orange dusk sky. Frame 8 (1:36.8) is the same pair, sun-backlit, so the shot begins around 1:36.7, after the welding footage. The measured cut at 1:39.0 ends it, and frame 15 (1:39.2) is a different shot.
